name: flatc

smoke: echo 'table T{a:int;} root_type T;' > t.fbs && flatc --cpp t.fbs && test -f t_generated.h && echo OK

name: sox

EXCLUDE: sox.c, example*.c, sox_sample_test.c, *coreaudio.c, alsa.c, ao.c, pulseaudio*, sndio.c, sunaudio.c, oss*, waveaudio*, flac.c, sndfile.c, mp3.c, opus*, vorbis*, wavpack.c, amr*.c, spectrogram.c (needs PNG), win32-*. deps (in-tree, built-in, no external libs): libgsm/*.c (for gsm format) + lpc10/*.c (for lpc10 format) — both plain-C amalgams already vendored in the tarball; add their .c globs as :compile_only too, with -Ilibgsm -Ilpc10 and define EXTERNAL_GSM/EXTERNAL_LPC10 UNSET. config: hand-write src/soxconfig.h (all #undef except HAVE_STDINT_H/STRING_H/STRINGS_H/UNISTD_H/FCNTL_H/INTTYPES_H/SYS_TYPES_H/SYS_STAT_H/VSNPRINTF/STRCASECMP/STRDUP/STDC_HEADERS=1 and PACKAGE_VERSION="14.4.2"); leave HAVE_LIBLTDL/HAVE_POPEN/all codec HAVE_* undefined so only built-in formats/effects register. sox.h ships pre-generated (version 14.4.2 baked, SOX_LIB_VERSION_CODE present) — do not regenerate. cflags: -I src -I src/libgsm -I src/lpc10 -DNDEBUG -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -Wno-incompatible-function-pointer-types -Wno-format -fno-strict-aliasing. extra_sources_main=none (library target; expose lsx/sox_* entrypoints, drive via a tiny wasm shim calling sox_init/sox_open_read/sox_open_write/effects chain).
smoke: curl -fsIL the 14.4.2 tarball -> HTTP 200, 1134299 bytes (verified). Extracted; libsox source list is an EXPLICIT literal enumeration in src/Makefile.am (no glob/codegen needed). Wrote a hand-made src/soxconfig.h (all-#undef template, only POSIX HAVE_*_H + STDC set) and ran clang -fsyntax-only on representative core sources targeting host clang: wav.c, effects.c, formats.c, reverb.c all parse CLEAN (warnings only). au.c throws one incompatible-function-pointer-types diagnostic from the uint64_t-vs-long seek typedef — cosmetic, cleared by -Wno-incompatible-function-pointer-types (SoX ships these suppressed). No configure run, no flex/bison/m4/autoheader needed; sox.h + soxconfig.h.in confirm config is pure preprocessor substitution. No unconditional fork/exec/popen/system anywhere in libsox (grep clean); all process/dlopen paths gated behind HAVE_LIBLTDL/HAVE_POPEN which stay undefined.
blocker: None structural. Two minor, lane-handled items: (1) the sox CLI driver (sox.c) is NOT buildable (termios/glob/signal/realtime-audio) — build the LIBRARY (libsox) + a thin wasm shim instead, which is the right artifact anyway; (2) the LP64-vs-ILP32 seek function-pointer typedef mismatch needs -Wno-incompatible-function-pointer-types. Neither needs per-tool host work.

name: git
build_opts: deps: [libgit2 v1.7.2 tarball]. src_globs: src/libgit2/**/*.c, src/util/**/*.c, deps/xdiff/*.c, deps/llhttp/*.c, deps/pcre/*.c, deps/zlib/*.c. exclude: src/util/win32/**, src/libgit2/win32/**, src/util/hash/openssl.c, src/util/hash/mbedtls.c, src/util/hash/win32.c, src/util/hash/common_crypto.c, **/sha1dc/** (keep builtin sha via deps/zlib or src/util/hash/builtin.c — pick exactly one sha backend), src/cli/** (skip the CLI git binary first; build lib then add a single src/cli main). cflags: --target=wasm32-wasi --sysroot=$SYSROOT -DLIBGIT2_NO_FEATURES_H -DGIT_ARCH_32_or_64 -DGIT_THREADS=0 -DGIT_HTTPS=0 -DGIT_SSH=0 -DGIT_USE_NSEC=0 -DGIT_REGEX_BUILTIN=1 -DGIT_SHA1_BUILTIN=1 -DGIT_SHA256_BUILTIN=1 -DGIT_IO_POLL=0 -DGIT_IO_SELECT=0 -Isrc/util -Isrc/libgit2 -Iinclude -Ideps/xdiff -Ideps/llhttp -Ideps/pcre -Ideps/zlib -DNO_VIZ -DSTDC. extra_sources main: thin src/cli/cli.c (git CLI entrypoint) compiled last and linked against the lib objects. Hand-write include/git2_features.h-equivalent via -D set above (NO_FEATURES_H path); disable threads/tls/ssh/http-network features that need sockets.
smoke: echo files into a tmp dir; run: git init /tmp/r && git add . && git commit -m x && git log --oneline (local object/refs ops only — no network clone/fetch).
blocker: Network transports (clone/fetch/push over http/ssh) are unreachable in-sandbox: no sockets/TLS — those subcommands compile out (GIT_HTTPS=0/GIT_SSH=0). Threads disabled (GIT_THREADS=0). Must pick exactly ONE sha1/sha256 backend (builtin) and exclude the rest, and exclude all win32/ + openssl/mbedtls/commoncrypto hash sources or you get duplicate symbols / missing headers. The bundled CLI (src/cli) is secondary — build the library first, then a thin main; if CLI source-list proves fiddly, the libgit2 library itself is the live-buildable artifact.
